strategy_references.text: Entyvio net-revenue erosion over the three years after first meaningful U.S. biosimilar entry.
strategy_references.rationale: Range 40-80%. Illustrative bracket from Eylea U.S. net sales -42% in 2025 and Humira -78.6% over 2022-2025, both different products [CLM-011017] [CLM-003002]. Not a forecast. Applied to FY2025 Entyvio JPY 958.0bn [CLM-005009] gives JPY 380-770bn of annual revenue at risk by year three.

strategy_references.name: Governed cross-franchise R&D data and decision layer
strategy_references.thesis: Make Takeda's own trial, real-world, assay and plasma data reusable under one governed layer so that a small number of named decisions (target choice, trial design, supply planning) can be measured against a pre-agreed baseline. (RECOMMENDATION, conditional on IVB-001.)

strategy_references.name: AI use-case measurement, decision support and reskilling
strategy_references.thesis: Measure a small set of AI use cases against pre-agreed baselines, prune early, pilot AI decision support that advises humans only, and publish a reskilling plan measured by task capability. (HYPOTHESIS) [CLM-011080] [CLM-011081] [CLM-011074]

strategy_references.name: Milestone-gated AI-design partnerships (Nabla, Iambic and successors)
strategy_references.thesis: Keep AI-design alliances but tie each scale-up to first-in-human or Phase 2 data with pre-agreed stop rules; do not pay for scale on vendor claims. (RECOMMENDATION) [CLM-011060] [CLM-006058]

strategy_references.name: Rented automated data generation (CRO and cloud labs) with ladder triggers
strategy_references.thesis: Buy stage 1-2 automated data generation as a service, run one stage-3 pilot only on explicit triggers, and do not build an owned robotic lab. (RECOMMENDATION) [CLM-011065] [CLM-011066]

strategy_references.name: Owned autonomous discovery lab (stage 4-5)
strategy_references.thesis: Build an owned closed-loop autonomous lab. Not supported by evidence today; recorded as a rejected alternative with revisit triggers. (RECOMMENDATION: REJECT now.)

strategy_references.name: Entyvio franchise defence: payer contracting, evidence and lifecycle
strategy_references.thesis: Build payer-contracting and formulary-defence depth, outcomes evidence and lifecycle plans for Entyvio ahead of Medicare negotiation (January 2028) and biosimilar entry, to delay erosion and measure it. The outcome is 'delay and measure', not 'retain revenue': the January 2028 price is statutory and PBM private-label biosimilars route around contracts. (RECOMMENDATION) [CLM-011072] [CLM-007026] [CLM-007015]

strategy_references.name: Drug-device and home/SC administration platform
strategy_references.thesis: Extend drug-device combinations (pens, needle-free transfer, home infusion) as the cheaper Intuitive-style pull-through, instead of surgical or lab robotics. (HYPOTHESIS) [CLM-011048]

strategy_references.name: Launch-pathway partnerships and patient-services outcome measurement
strategy_references.thesis: Attach a diagnosis and certified-site pathway pilot to the oveporexton (Orzeyful) launch with a named leader, starting 2027 H1, and measure time-to-therapy and persistence before any redesign. Capped at USD 50m. (HYPOTHESIS) [CLM-011070] [CLM-005029]

record.milestone: Gate: Entyvio benefit-channel split (medical versus pharmacy, IVB-004), erosion scenarios and patent posture approved; if most volume is outside the contractable channel, redirect part of the BET-04 spend to provider and site-of-care strategy.

strategy_references.text: Leverage ceiling after any USD 5bn+ acquisition before dividend or buyback policy is revisited.
strategy_references.rationale: Takeda was 2.6x at March 2026 and 3.1x at March 2024 [CLM-005005]; ceiling is a planning assumption, not a Takeda policy.

strategy_references.text: Debt headroom to the ASM-033 leverage ceiling after the Amitiza provision is debt-funded (council arithmetic).
strategy_references.rationale: Council arithmetic from registry values, free cash flow and acquired earnings ignored: adjusted net debt JPY 3,817.6bn at 2.6x implies EBITDA JPY 1,457.2bn [CLM-005005]; a 3.0x ceiling allows JPY 4,371.6bn, so headroom is JPY 554.0bn before and JPY 150.5bn after a JPY 403.5bn Amitiza outflow [CLM-005014]; at ASM-001 that is about USD 3.7bn and USD 1.0bn. A USD 5bn purchase gives about 3.13x and about 3.41x with Amitiza.

strategy_references.name: Large asset purchase (USD 5bn or more) as LOE bridge
strategy_references.thesis: A single USD 5bn+ acquisition as the LOE bridge. (RECOMMENDATION: REJECT as framed; the bridge is a funded Phase 2/3 licensing channel, BET-18.)

strategy_references.name: Phase 2/3 in-licensing channel
strategy_references.thesis: Hold a standing channel for Phase 2/3 in-licences and option-to-acquire deals with a per-deal upfront ceiling of USD 0.5-2bn (ASM-118), contingent on Amitiza cash (IVB-012) and the 3.0x leverage ceiling (ASM-033), so that the Entyvio refill gap (2031-2034) has a funded instrument that BET-06 (payoff 2035+) and BET-15 (fails the leverage test) cannot supply. (RECOMMENDATION, council-proposed, adopted by the Director in v2.)

strategy_references.name: Plasma process-intelligence and fixed-price automation programme
strategy_references.thesis: Test whether donor, yield and process data from the plasma network are a proprietary data class (no plasma peer is in the comparison set, so uniqueness is untested) by funding only a baseline, a demand-versus-capacity test, a plasma-peer benchmark and a one-site shadow-mode tranche before any fixed-price automation or network roll-out. (HYPOTHESIS) [CLM-011056] [CLM-011031]

strategy_references.name: Orexin science as a multi-asset discovery platform
strategy_references.thesis: Run orexin biology as a platform with a second differentiated asset, funded at the constrained discovery size, with a Phase 1 gate before the H2 tranche, an additionality test against base R&D and a competitor orexin scan. (HYPOTHESIS) [CLM-011038]

strategy_references.name: Option-based external innovation engine incl. new-modality options
strategy_references.thesis: Use option and early-licence structures with small upfronts and gated exercise for one or two modalities adjacent to existing disease depth (for example RNAi next to fazirsiran), scorecard-first, at the strategy's own constrained size; the balance of the v1 size is contingent on the deal-outcome scorecard (RM-007) and the first two deals (RM-019). (HYPOTHESIS) [CLM-011061]

strategy_references.text: JPY per USD used only to size strategic-bet envelopes against disclosed Takeda JPY figures.
strategy_references.rationale: Round planning rate, not a forecast. Takeda R&D JPY 675.9bn [CLM-005004] converts to about USD 4.5bn at this rate; Takeda amounts otherwise stay in JPY.

strategy_references.text: Balanced portfolio: committed-at-gates strategic-bet envelope, cumulative 2027-2040 (sum of v2 bet sizings; v1 was USD 2,950m).
strategy_references.rationale: Takeda's budget is not public (IVB-014). v2: USD 1,920m committed at gates plus about USD 1,030m contingent headroom reserved for BET-18 (ASM-118), which is not a saving. Anchors for scale: Lilly-NVIDIA lab up to USD 1bn over 5 years, joint [CLM-000281]; Nimbus USD 4.0bn upfront [CLM-009076]; AbbVie early-stage stream USD 0.6-1.0bn a year [CLM-009097]. About 3.0% of 14 years of flat R&D at ASM-001; incremental to base R&D and base plant capex (ASM-035).

strategy_references.text: BET-18 contingent pool, balanced portfolio (per-deal upfront ceiling range USD 500-2,000m).
strategy_references.rationale: Council suggestion of a per-deal ceiling of USD 0.5-2bn, to be set after IVB-012. The balanced pool equals the headroom freed by the v2 changes (BET-06 400, BET-03 200, BET-02 200, BET-07 100, BET-13 80, BET-12 50); constrained pool 500 and ambitious pool 2,000 are the range ends. Not committed; released only if the leverage test (ASM-033, ASM-119) passes. Comparators: Innovent USD 1.2bn upfront [CLM-009078]; Nimbus USD 4.0bn upfront exceeds the ceiling [CLM-009076].
